description: Windows screenshot capture and annotation tool with scrolling capture, numbered steps, privacy masks, and save profiles.

checkver.script: $page = (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://www.framecapt.com/' -UseBasicParsing).Content; $match = [regex]::Match([string]$page, '(?is)\bversion\s*(?:</?[^>]+>\s*)*v?([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)\b'); if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Could not extract the FrameCapt version from the official homepage.' }; $match.Groups[1].Value
